contradicting_evidence: There is a plausible upside case: BTC and ETH rose in the latest completed hour, with taker-buy quote shares around 59%, while ETH/BTC also advanced.
There is a plausible downside case: only 32% of the breadth universe advanced, the median return was negative, and all observed alt-bucket medians were negative.
frozen_forecast.expected_path: Two-sided stabilization or a brief extension of the hourly bounce is plausible, but neither sustained continuation nor an immediate renewed decline has enough confirmation. BTC/ETH firmness may coexist with continued altcoin weakness.
falsification_conditions: Repeated completed-hour advances supported by persistent spot buying, sustained ETH/BTC strength and broader participation would resolve uncertainty toward UP.
Reversal of the latest hourly gains alongside persistent spot selling and further breadth deterioration would resolve uncertainty toward DOWN.
missing_evidence: Persistence of the latest price, taker-flow and ETH/BTC improvements beyond one completed hour.
A fresh breadth observation aligned with the latest hourly market data.
Contemporaneous order-book behavior showing whether earlier ask-heavy depth remains relevant.
supporting_evidence: The latest hour shows modest BTC/ETH gains and small increases in open interest, but that combination alone does not distinguish durable demand from a fragile leveraged bounce.
Positive hourly price action conflicts with weak broader participation, preventing a clean short-horizon directional conclusion.
Positive funding and long/short ratios of 2.77 for BTC and 3.31 for ETH indicate long-side positioning, but no historical baseline establishes exceptional crowding.
The earlier snapshot combined positive taker imbalance with ask-heavy depth; this is conflicting, time-limited evidence rather than proof of either recovery or rejection.
